release_bundle_slot.schema_note: docs/attestations/schema.json does not yet define a separate tui/topology-parity category, so the release bundle hashes this artifact under tui/render-parity while proof_category 11 records the topological-invariant method.

scope.summary: Complementary glyph-level visual-regression metric for SSIM parity. It compares H0/H1 persistence diagrams over rendered glyph alpha/luma bitmaps.

metric_contract.filtration: ink-super-level over nonzero grayscale pixel values
metric_contract.h1_definition: background components that do not touch the image border
metric_contract.distance: per-dimension bottleneck distance, equivalent to the W-infinity persistence-diagram matching metric

corpus_contract.oracle_render: ratatui or upstream WezTerm glyph bitmap emitted by the render-parity harness
corpus_contract.subject_render: ftui or FrankenTerm glyph bitmap emitted by the render-parity harness

current_status.reason: The repository now contains the topology metric crate and release slot. Full pass/fail evidence requires the render harness to emit paired glyph bitmaps for the terminal-conformance expected fixtures.
